### Day of Death
Author: Scott Devor
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/day-death
Passage: Ecclesiastes 7:1-4
Points:
- Mourning and sorrow provide a depth of wisdom and perspective that festive celebrations cannot produce.
- Confronting mortality compels people to reflect on the fragility and eternal significance of human life.
- The sobering reality of death points believers to Christ, who overcame the grave and promises resurrection.

### Sit at the Feet of Loss: What Endings Teach the Living
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/sit-at-the-feet-of-loss
Passage: Ecclesiastes 7:1
Points:
- Wisdom is cultivated by confronting uncomfortable realities rather than escaping into superficial distractions.
- The reality of death speaks an urgent message to the living to order their days with eternity in view.
- The conclusion of an endeavor or life reveals what beginnings often conceal about where we place our trust.
- Grieving loss clarifies what matters most by stripping away earthly pretenses and anchoring hope in Christ.

### Why Is Wisdom So Special?
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/why-is-wisdom-so-special
Passage: Ecclesiastes 7:13-14
Points:
- Wisdom protects believers from common human pitfalls like pride, disillusionment, and bitterness.
- Embracing divine sovereignty replaces frantic resistance with relief, recognizing God is ultimately in control.
- Good times should be embraced with gratitude and enjoyed freely without unnecessary guilt.
- God weaves both prosperity and adversity into life so that believers walk by faith rather than sight.
